### A Life with Extraordinary Impact - Encouragement for Today - July 20, 2017
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-july-20-2017.html
Passage: Judges 3:31
Points:
- God uses ordinary individuals in everyday jobs to make an eternal, extraordinary difference.
- Shamgar seemed like an unlikely deliverer, facing 600 Philistine warriors with only a cattle prod.
- Believers must offer God their willingness instead of disqualifying themselves over their limitations.
- We are called to sharpen and surrender whatever gifts, talents, or tools are already in our hands.
- God does not expect us to become someone else, but to obey Him as the persons He created us to be.

### God Can Use What's in Your Hand - Beloved Women - April 11, 2019
Author: Beloved Women
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/beloved-women/beloved-women-april-11-2019.html
Passage: Judges 3:31
Points:
- Shamgar defeated 600 formidable Philistine warriors armed solely with a wooden ox goad.
- God's sovereignty is displayed when He takes common agricultural implements to accomplish national deliverance.
- Christians are called to stand against modern spiritual enemies using whatever tools and gifts they possess.
- Submitting whatever is in your hand to God enables Him to use it for His glory.
